kinds.a: mouse trap · rat trap · snap trap · glue board · electronic rat trap
kinds.d: A trap that kills a mouse or rat by spring, sticky board or electric shock.

kinds.a: humane trap · cage trap · live trap
kinds.d: A wire cage trap that catches a rodent or small animal alive for release.

kinds.a: rat poison · mouse bait · bait box · tamper-resistant bait station · bait station key
kinds.d: Poison bait for mice and rats, and the lockable box that holds it so only the pest can reach it.

kinds.a: ultrasonic pest repeller · rodent repellent · moth repellent · mothballs · cedar block
kinds.d: A device or substance set around the home to drive rodents, insects or moths away without trapping or killing them.

kinds.a: bird spikes · pigeon spikes · bird netting · bird gel · bird scarer · decoy owl
kinds.d: Netting, spikes, coils, gel dishes or decoys fitted on ledges, roofs and gardens to stop birds landing or nesting.

notes: Snap, glue and electronic rodent traps merged into one Rodent trap kind with the three as types; dropped Little Pete Mechanical Mouse Trap as a second JT Eaton snap trap (duplicate brand). Rodenticide bait, bait station and bait-station key merged; the key kept as a spare-part type rather than its own kind. Electronic, chemical and moth repellents merged into Pest repeller with types. Bird netting, bird spike and ledge deterrent merged into Bird deterrent with types; dropped StealthNet (building-contractor netting, trade only) and the Bird-Flite and Gutter-Point spikes as duplicates of the same maker, keeping one spike and one coil. No new kinds, archetypes or brands added (restraint-only shelf); old source URLs retained. Model lists remain thin and Bird Barrier/JT Eaton skew persists — the brief's extra tier brands (Big Cheese/STV, Rentokil, Havahart) would need sourced lookups in a research pass.
